comment: Website-local (not a desktop vector): sync-v2.md §7/§14 — the @app and dataset writeback legs are LIVE now that the app signs POST /api/v1/sync/changes with hub_request Bearer for a Website origin (learning/fms-app src-tauri/src/sync/client/auth.rs, writeback.rs). This vector pins the route's per-change REQUEST-SHAPE coercion (lib/sync/change_log.ts normalizeChange) against the app's LITERAL push bodies, so a wire-shape regression in the now-live entry point is caught without a DB or an HTTP harness. dataset_uuid:null resolves to the @app scope through scopeFor (mirroring the app's scope_for); a non-string dataset_uuid for a shared-content kind yields the empty scope, which the route then routes to the dataset authority-branch refusal. edit_time is passed through verbatim (the route clamps it via INV-6 downstream); a pre-Phase-5 queue row sends '' and that must coerce to '', not null/undefined. The app carries epoch as #[serde(default)] i64, so absent/junk is 0 and a float is truncated like a seq cursor (never sneaks a fractional past the INV-13 `presented < authority` compare). A missing id OR non-string/empty id, and likewise kind, flags missing so the route refuses the change — the empty-id/empty-kind guard must not be reachable past normalizeChange.
